test_document_content_to_text: test the Document.text property converts text-only content to a string representation
test_document_with_image: test the Document class handles image-only content and returns '<image/jpeg>' placeholder
test_document_multimodal: test the Document class combines text and image chunks into a single text string
test_document_empty: test the Document class handles empty content and returns an empty string
test_document_str_conversion: test explicit and implicit str conversion of Document.content matches the text property
